edges.reason: id parameter indexes the tokenInput mapping written by ownerAddInputTokenForSwap
_inputToken parameter is stored into tokenInput[id].addr
_inputRate parameter is stored into tokenInput[id].rateInput
_outputRate parameter is stored into tokenInput[id].rateOutput
ownerAddInputTokenForSwap writes tokenInput state mapping
id parameter selects the balances sub-mapping in ownerSetupTokenBalance
accounts array supplies keys for balances writes and loop bound
amount array supplies values written into balances
ownerSetupTokenBalance writes balances[id][accounts[i]]
ownerSetupTokenBalance accumulates totalDevidend via add/mul/div arithmetic
ownerSetupTokenBalance reads tokenInput[id].rateOutput and rateInput
loop counter i is initialized and incremented over accounts.length
account parameter is used to read balances[i][account] in getClaimableAmount
balances mapping read to compute the account dividend
tokenInput rates read inside the getClaimableAmount loop
tokenAccel.balanceOf(address(this)) used to size the token payout
totalDevidend used as the denominator of the payout pro-rata calculation
yourDividend local accumulates each token's dividend share
yourDividend feeds tokens = balance * yourDividend / totalDevidend
yourDividend feeds eth = balance * yourDividend / totalDevidend
yourDividend is returned as the dividend value
loop counter i iterates the three token input slots
claim consumes the tokens, eth and dividend values returned by getClaimableAmount
msg.sender controls the claimed mapping lookup and payout recipient in claim
claimed[msg.sender] is read as the re-claim guard
claim writes claimed[msg.sender] = true before payouts
tokens value determines the amount passed to tokenAccel.transfer
eth value determines the amount sent via payable(msg.sender).transfer
claim performs the tokenAccel.transfer external call
claim performs the payable(msg.sender).transfer ETH send
claim decrements totalDevidend by the user dividend
totalDevidend is the left operand of the subtraction
dividend is the right operand of the unchecked subtraction
result of the subtraction is written back to totalDevidend
msg.sender is the recipient of all drained funds in ownerWithdrawEthAndToken
tokenAccel is the contract invoked by the drain transfer
ownerWithdrawEthAndToken executes tokenAccel.transfer to msg.sender
ownerWithdrawEthAndToken executes the ETH balance transfer to msg.sender
tokenAccel is the contract invoked by the claim payout transfer
msg.sender/ _msgSender() is compared with owner() inside the onlyOwner modifier

onlyOwner modifier restricts ownerWithdrawEthAndToken

owner() is evaluated by the require check in onlyOwner
newOwner parameter is validated and stored into _owner

constructor assigns the tokenAccel state variable

normalization_plan.reason: id is a transient function argument only used to index tokenInput inside ownerAddInputTokenForSwap
_inputToken is copied into tokenInput[id].addr within ownerAddInputTokenForSwap
_inputRate is copied into tokenInput[id].rateInput within ownerAddInputTokenForSwap
_outputRate is copied into tokenInput[id].rateOutput within ownerAddInputTokenForSwap
id only selects the balances sub-mapping inside ownerSetupTokenBalance
accounts is consumed entirely by the loop in ownerSetupTokenBalance
amount is consumed entirely by the loop in ownerSetupTokenBalance
account is only used to read balances inside getClaimableAmount
newOwner is validated and stored into _owner only inside transferOwnership
yourDividend is a temporary accumulator fully contained in getClaimableAmount
tokens is a temporary return-value binding used only to call transfer inside claim
eth is a temporary return-value binding used only to send ETH inside claim
dividend is a temporary return-value binding used only in the totalDevidend subtraction inside claim
loop counter i exists only for the iteration in ownerSetupTokenBalance
loop counter i exists only for the three-slot iteration in getClaimableAmount
msgSender is a constructor-local alias of _msgSender() used to initialise ownership
